self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Whispers of Wind and Flower: within 8s after an Elemental Skill hits an opponent, ATK +12% and Elemental Mastery +48. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1). Was previously modelled as an unconditional self_modifiers_json entry holding the R5 numbers, which handed every refinement the R5 buff with no skill-hit requirement.
